seoTitle: ISBN Validator and ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 Converter
metaDescription: Check ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 check digits and convert between them, many at once. Free, offline, no book lookup.
intro: Check the check digit of ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 numbers and convert between the two forms. Works offline; it does not look up the book.
why:
A wrong digit in an ISBN sends an order to the wrong book. The last digit is a check digit, so most typing errors can be caught offline.

Paste ISBNs, one per line, with or without hyphens. The tool checks ISBN-10 (weights 10 to 1, modulus 11, X for ten) and ISBN-13 (weights 1 and 3, modulus 10) and converts between the two. ISBNs starting 979 have no ISBN-10. It does not add hyphens, which needs the agency's range tables, or look up the book.
howTo: Read the type and result for each.
Look up valid numbers in a library or shop for the book itself.

faq.q: Does a valid ISBN mean the book exists?
faq.a: No. It only means the check digit is right.

faq.q: Why is there no ISBN-10 for some?
faq.a: ISBN-10 maps only to 978 numbers. 979 numbers were created later.
Hyphen positions depend on published range tables that change, so this tool leaves them out.
